RPI_WIRELESS_OFF.SECTION_CHIPS_DOC: Switch a chip off and reboot, and the Pi starts as if that chip weren't there.
RPI_WIRELESS_OFF.WIFI_CHIP_DOC: Off means the chip gets no power. Turning it off needs a wired network connection, because without Wi-Fi Volumio can't start its rescue hotspot.
RPI_WIRELESS_OFF.BT_CHIP_DOC: Off means the chip gets no power, so phones can't see this player or pair with it.
RPI_WIRELESS_OFF.HAND_SET_DOC: Off, set by hand in /boot/userconfig.txt. Delete that line to manage this chip here.
RPI_WIRELESS_OFF.NOT_SUPPORTED: This plugin works on the Raspberry Pi 4, Pi 400 and Compute Module 4 only. It does nothing on this player.
RPI_WIRELESS_OFF.STATUS_WIFI_TURNS_OFF: Wi-Fi chip turns off at the next boot.
RPI_WIRELESS_OFF.STATUS_WIFI_TURNS_ON: Wi-Fi chip turns on at the next boot.
RPI_WIRELESS_OFF.STATUS_BT_TURNS_OFF: Bluetooth chip turns off at the next boot.
RPI_WIRELESS_OFF.STATUS_BT_TURNS_ON: Bluetooth chip turns on at the next boot.
RPI_WIRELESS_OFF.HEALTH: Health: volumio restarted {{volumio}} times since boot, volumiobt {{volumiobt}}. Failed units: {{failed}}.
RPI_WIRELESS_OFF.NO_WIRED_LINK: Connect Ethernet first. With the Wi-Fi chip off, Volumio can't start its rescue hotspot, so a dead cable would leave the SD card as the only way back in.
RPI_WIRELESS_OFF.DAMAGED_BLOCK: The rpi_wireless_off block in /boot/userconfig.txt is damaged. Fix or delete it by hand, then save again.
RPI_WIRELESS_OFF.HAND_SET_IGNORED: A chip set by hand in /boot/userconfig.txt was left as it is.
RPI_WIRELESS_OFF.SAVED: Saved. The change applies at the next boot.
RPI_WIRELESS_OFF.REBOOT_MSG: The chips change state when the Pi starts. Reboot now?
RPI_WIRELESS_OFF.COMING_BACK_ON: {{chips}} will turn back on at the next boot. To keep a chip off, switch it off again in RPi Wireless Off.
RPI_WIRELESS_OFF.GENERATOR_FAILED: Couldn't install the boot helper: {{error}}. While a chip is off, Volumio's Bluetooth or Wi-Fi service may restart in a loop.
